title: MockLab: channel/agent messages actually send (no dead composer)
notes: Follow-up shipped: the 503 transport hardening alone left GET /chat/threads/:id/history and brain-RPC routes 500ing on a dead gateway (unhandled fetch failed in fetchChatHistory/getInstanceOwner/openChatEventStream/invokeBrainRpc). Fixed + regression-tested (real RelayClient vs dead socket: history stays 200 with durable transcript, send stays structured-503, no silent history append). Live repro stack (CP+ORCHESTRATOR_FAKE+BFF harness mode+fake LA): channel @mention send → 200, persona turn streamed over SSE, history hydrates. PR #623 (CI green) merged as 22749d9.
close_reason: Root cause reproduced on the live demo stack (Hermes/gateway off — the QA condition): every channel send died as an unhandled TypeError 'fetch failed' → bare 500 'Internal server error' from POST /api/chat/threads/:id/messages; user bubble showed 'Failed' with a generic toast and no actionable reason. Fix: RelayClient.deliverInbound/interruptInbound + HarnessClient.startTurn/interruptTurn now map network-level failures to the existing {ok:false} shape as structured 503s with actionable text ('Agent gateway unreachable at <url> — start the gateway (or set ChatDelivery=harness) and retry.'); send route's existing mapping surfaces it, client marks the message Failed/retryable — no silent drop, composer stays usable (lp-mrh pattern). Verified live: before SEND 500 'Internal server error' → after SEND 503 structured message. Actually delivering turns requires the gateway/runtime up — wire-side lead-wake/delivery is the paired lac-xsb work; ops runtime bring-up stays with the lab stack owner. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/621 (merged). title: CP migrate: CREATE INDEX on scope before ADD COLUMN (live boot crash)
description:
Live MockLab CP :28 (image lp-xhf4-0ea5d957 digest sha256:af599cd0ee67637ef5f9b02bb29cb775901a13651bdab6bb8fec643f35c3e1b7) exited 1 on migrate: column "scope" does not exist (pg 42703, indexcmds.c ComputeIndexAttrs).

Root cause: migrate.ts initial CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch also CREATE INDEX idx_gateway_instances_tenant_scope and idx_gateway_instances_user_owner on gateway_instances.scope. Existing RDS (pre-xhf4.6) already has gateway_instances without scope, so CREATE TABLE is a no-op and CREATE INDEX fails before ensureOptionalColumns ADD COLUMN scope.

Also blocking the same cutover (same origin/main 0ea5d957):
- packages/bff/src/app.ts duplicate imports CreateChannelError / SetChannelLeadError / stampGroupDeliverInbound fail tsc in BFF Docker
- BFF and CP Dockerfiles need COPY packages/connectors so the workspace graph installs

Fix belongs on main. Live cutover applies it in /tmp/lp-cutover-main then rebuilds CP image and rolls ECS. Do not terraform apply torn-down staging; existing MockLab cluster only.
close_reason: Fix landed on main via PR #609 (squash merge 50dd05d0; CI green: Portal tests, Offline validate, aggregate). Changes: scope indexes idx_gateway_instances_tenant_scope/idx_gateway_instances_user_owner now created after ensureOptionalColumns (+ordering regression test), duplicate BFF imports removed, BFF+CP Dockerfiles COPY packages/connectors. description: Pre-existing outage, discovered during lp-oop.38.25.1 canary. Facts: (1) gateway_instances 452b1348… presence=offline/last_seen_at=null BEFORE any changes today; chat QA worked until ~03:00 Aug 23. (2) ensure_online times out (504 ENSURE_ONLINE_TIMEOUT 60s) identically on old tool-only snapshot b13c2b8d AND new la-main c778027 snapshot 1c3365d3. (3) Sandboxes create fine: correct env (GATEWAY_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.withlanyard.com, vault bucket+STS creds), mountpoint-s3 mounts /mnt/vault. (4) Relay healthy publicly (/health 200) but logs only its startup line — no dial logging. (5) Guest exec shows NO gateway process running and entrypoint exit_code=1 with empty captured output. Need: Daytona dashboard guest logs for sandbox 6c6cd643-525b-4942-924d-a748b17f7c7f (la-main snapshot) to find the entrypoint failure, OR add relay dial logging. Note: instance was pinned to tool-only-f63beffd-20260819c which has an EMPTY /opt/company-brain-backend/current/bin (no gateway binary at all) — that pin could never serve chat.
notes: POST-CLOSE follow-up discovered in live QA: fresh CP-created sandbox 923e08b9 had NO vault mount + no gateway.env (chat worked; durable state lost) — distinct from the writability race fixed here. close_reason: Root cause found + fixed + shipped. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/604 (merged). Forensics: cold Mountpoint mounts took 60–125s to become writable by uid 990 vs 30s entrypoint retry → fail-closed before gateway start; also stale cached COPY layer shipped an ancient entrypoint (now guarded by md5 check in build-local.sh). Live proof: rebuilt image, snapshot lanyard-la-main-c7780271be4e-20260823e (70589677), MockLab instance 452b1348 woke presence=online with relay adapter connected. Follow-ups filed separately (emit verification + vault-mount drift).

title: Channel room UX: named # rooms + iMessage bubbles (Buzz-like)
description:
## Why
Buzz-style rooms: named channels where agents coordinate with each other. Current IA (lp-cxhb) and speaker timeline (lac-bx3.16) still read as one chat with extra icons, not a group room.

1:1 agent chats stay ghost / Meta Astryx. This epic is CHANNELS ONLY.

## Scope
1. Sidenav channels: `#name` text, no avatar, no recency/date line. Must not look like agent rows.
2. Chat chrome: no lead selector, no member roster in the transcript. Click the channel name in the header to open members + purposes.
3. Transcript: Astryx ChatMessage / ChatMessageBubble grouping (Jack’s ChatMessageBubbleGrouping sample). Dither next to bubbles, sender name, time, delivered receipts. No model name, no regenerate/copy. WhatsApp/iMessage group chat feel.
4. No tool-call / activity dump in channel chats (too noisy). Agent text is markdown. Agents can @ each other.
5. Prove with portal web-ui-testing / Playwright on demo.localhost. 1:1 ghost path must stay unchanged.

## Non-goals
- Changing 1:1 ghost UI
- Harness wake/hop-cap (stays lac-bx3)
- Landing on main before integrate/lac-bx3 + UI prove

## Branch
Worktrees off integrate/lac-bx3. Merge bead branches into integrate/lac-bx3, not main.

title: Agent-to-agent autonomous exchange on harness path (wake-policy hop, no user input)
description:
Child of lp-znef. After a persona harness turn completes (SSE done), BFF evaluates decideWake (portal/packages/bff/src/wake-policy.ts) on the agent reply with reason=hop: if another persona should speak (e.g. reply addresses/@them or policy says pass), BFF starts the next harness turn for that persona with the agent reply as inbound — no user input. Hop cap (existing E1-E3 cap) prevents loops. Turn order stays serialized per thread (thread-turn-queue semantics).

Acceptance:
- Unit: hop wake decision starts next persona turn; cap stops the chain; no cross-thread bleed.
- E2E (fake LiteLLM): two agents exchange >=2 autonomous turns after one user message, then stop at cap.
- Live proof: real stack, two agents converse back and forth without further user input; transcript captured under artifacts/ui/.

Prove: BFF suites + e2e + live transcript artifact.
close_reason: harness-hop.ts composes rosterFromThread+parseRosterMentions+decidePersonaHop; app.ts serializes per-thread hop chains on turn completion with generation/handled dedupe and MAX_HOP_CHAIN_TURNS=8 guard. Fixed live finding: channels persist participants without display_name so @Name mentions never matched — catalog names now joined for wake+hop mention parsing. Unit: 12 hop tests incl cap/self-loop/cross-thread. Live: ONE user message -> ZnefAlice->ZnefBob->ZnefAlice then loop_notice stop; transcript artifacts/ui/lp-znef. Committed d8a763bb.

Live: one user message produced 4 attributed agent replies across Alice<->Bob hops. Exactly-once turn claims prevent replay dupes. Pending merge with lp-cxhb.15.

title: Outbound speaker stamp on harness SSE: agent avatar + name per channel message
description:
Child of lp-znef. LA harness turn server echoes request.metadata.persona on message_send events (packages/adapters-portal/src/harness/server.ts / model-runner emit path). BFF harness SSE proxy (chat-delivery-events.ts / live events mapping) maps that metadata to HistorySpeaker so ChatTimeline renders ChatSpeakerLabel (DitherAvatar + name) on agent turns in channels — components already exist, they just never receive speaker on this path. History hydrate must survive reload (persist speaker on the stored turn).

Acceptance:
- Unit: harness message_send carries persona echo; BFF maps to speaker.
- Web: channel turn renders data-testid chat-speaker-avatar-persona-<id> + label; 1:1 unchanged.
- Live Playwright: send a channel message, assert two different agents' replies each show their own avatar+name.

Prove: BFF + web suites; Playwright on live harness stack.
close_reason: durableOutboundFromRelayEvent maps metadata.persona -> HistorySpeaker (persisted, participant-validated); proxyRelayBody promotes top-level speaker on re-emitted SSE; web ChatSpeakerLabel renders chat-speaker-avatar-persona-* / -name-persona-* on persona turns, hydrate survives reload, 1:1 unchanged. Web chat suites 89/89. Live Playwright PASS (artifacts/ui/lp-znef). Committed d8a763bb.

title: harness hop: persona speaker stamp + persona prompt on LA turns
description:
Live QA on the cutover stack (CHAT_DELIVERY=harness, LA harness turn server on :4310, LiteLLM real completions) proved the loop works but outbound message_send events carry speaker=None / persona_id=None, and the model replies as a generic assistant (persona name/objective not applied).

Relay path stamps outbound persona from the session (lac-bx3.12) and assembles persona prompts (lac-bx3.13). The harness hop (BFF startTurn -> LA /internal/turns -> SSE proxy) loses both.

Fix: carry persona identity + persona prompt layers in the TurnRequest metadata (or have LA resolve persona from thread participants) so harness-path group rooms show correct multi-speaker attribution and persona-faithful replies.

Evidence: sse capture on channel 890654fb (message_send speaker None x2); qa stack logs.
close_reason: Duplicate of lp-ighv (same harness-drop gap, filed in parallel). Persona prompt layer note added there; evidence (sse capture, speaker=None on message_send) applies to both.

title: Vault citation open: real files (sample_document.txt), not HTML-not-JSON
description:
Repro: click a chat citation such as sample_document.txt. Pane errors "vault returned HTML, not JSON". 38.22 taught fetchVaultContent to refuse HTML when CloudFront 404-rewrites missing S3 keys to index.html. That made the error honest. Opening a real text/doc citation still fails.

Cause: citation paths are often /mnt/vault/... or a sandbox-relative path that is not the BFF vault key. GET /api/vault/content then 404s as SPA HTML. Web throws on content-type html.

Fix: map citation paths to vault-relative keys (strip /mnt/vault, sandbox cwd). Serve the file as the existing JSON envelope (text files included). Human error if missing, never dump HTML. Live prove sample_document.txt or another real cited file opens.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a real vault file citation (e.g. sample_document.txt) opens the document pane with file text. No "HTML, not JSON". Missing files show a short not-found, not SPA HTML. Tests for path rewrite + HTML refusal remain.
notes:
Path rewrite: citationJoinRoot uses /mnt/vault when project sits under the guest mount so sample_document.txt maps to /sample_document.txt not Projects/Workspace. BFF serves .txt as utf-8 JSON (infer mime from path when S3 is octet-stream). Missing/SPA HTML maps to short File not found. Tests: path-project, vaultPaths, pane, fetchVaultContent HTML refusal, BFF sample_document + JSON 404.
Fix pass: live S3 had no sample_document.txt (head 404) so GET returned CloudFront SPA HTML. Seeded deploy/artifacts/mocklab-vault-seed/sample_document.txt + mockLabVaultSeedPack fill-missing. Live put to tenants/319d3808-e533-44db-bfdf-7b6ef8caaae1/vault/sample_document.txt (348 bytes, text/plain). PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/593 commit 5cd76c06. Do not bd close.

title: Stop attaching unopenable workflow state.json citation chips
description:
Repro: completed workflow turns grow chips like wf_<id>/state.json (often several, including extra call-* folders). They fail to open. Users do not want them. Evidence: artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.24/04-after-wait.png (sample_document.txt plus multiple state.json chips).

Cause: persistWorkflowStateToVault writes /mnt/vault/workflows/runs/{id}/state.json via toolbox; collectFileCitation then emits them as chat citations. Extra LiteLLM workflow call-* ids created extra folders (38.23 hid empty cards, not the files).

Fix: keep persisting state under vault for operators if needed, but do not emit those paths as chat citations. Filter workflow run state.json (and call-* run folders) out of the citation list. Do not ask the model to cite state.json.
acceptance_criteria: A completed research-lite turn has zero state.json citation chips. Vault may still have the file. Tests: collectFileCitation / citation merge skip workflows/runs/*/state.json.
notes:
Filter chat citations at shared omitWorkflowRunVaultCitations. Persist of workflows/runs state.json unchanged. Tests: shared run-vault, BFF durableOutbound, web citationsFromToolCalls + applyChatEvent merge.
PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/592 commit 0aac5c45. Not closed (merge stage after QA/CI).

title: Workflow card shows the run outcome, not backend run_id
description:
Repro: completed research-lite card is "research-lite · complete · 3/3 · 48s" with no findings. Assistant bubble and sidebar preview lead with "run_id: wf_249e3bb7c677e399" / "final status: completed". Users do not need the workflow or run id. Evidence: artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.25/01-thread.png.

Cause: progress.summary is just "Plan → Explore → Synthesize". Tool execute returns raw launch JSON (run_id, status, phases). The model copies that. Sidebar uses the last assistant text as the chat title.

Fix: terminal workflow tool result is a short human brief (what was found, not the run id). Project state.outcome / agent summaries onto the card. Do not render wf_* or run_id in the card, sidebar title, or citation labels. Backend ids may stay on the wire.
acceptance_criteria: After a completed research-lite turn, the card or the assistant follow-up states the outcome in plain language. Visible chat chrome (card, sidebar snippet, citation chips) has no wf_* / run_id. Tests cover mapper/card copy, not only the JSON shape.

title: Expanded workflow stages show nested helpers and stage output
description:
Repro (live Nimbus 823bfc50): expand Plan, Explore, or Synthesize on the research-lite card. Copy is "No nested activity yet". Timeline still has Listing files / Searching files / Reading documents from the nested helpers. QA: artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.25/QA.json stage_expand.*.no_nested=true, 02-expand-plan.png.

Cause: projectWorkflowProgressForPortal never fills stage.summary or stageSubagentIds. createHarnessWorkflowBind does not pass onChildLifecycle / stageSubagentIds. Portal WorkflowRunCard only hides the empty copy when summary, nested subagents, or toolCallIds exist. Nested spawn_agent runs on the workflow host, not as chat subagent rows, so the roster is empty.

Fix at the emit: map WorkflowRunState.agents onto stage subagentIds, dual-emit subagent_progress (or equivalent) with parent workflow_id + stage_id, and put each agent's summary on the stage. Portal already renders nested rows when those ids resolve. Do not invent fake rows when nothing ran.
acceptance_criteria: Live or fixture: expand a completed research-lite Plan/Explore/Synthesize stage. Each stage that spawned helpers shows those helpers (name + status) or a short stage summary from their output. "No nested activity yet" only when the stage truly did no nested work. Unit coverage on the progress projector and WorkflowRunCard.
notes: Platform side merged: PR #595 (squash 68b2ec4f). Evidence: reviewer approved 0 bugs (146/146 targeted tests); UI QA render-layer proof in real browser — Plan/Explore stages show nested helper rows + summaries, zero-agent stage keeps honest empty copy, hostile subagent_progress frames cause no crash/misroute (artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.25.1/). REMAINING for close: LA emit PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-agent/pull/265 merge+deploy, then live Nimbus QA that expanded stages show nested activity on a real run.
